name: What is the difference between a pre-hung door and a slab door?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a pre-hung door and a slab door?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pre-hung door comes pre-assembled in a frame with hinges already attached, making installation generally quicker and simpler, especially for new construction or when replacing an entire door unit. A slab door is just the door panel itself, without a frame or hinges. Slab doors are often chosen when the existing door frame is in good condition and only the door panel needs replacement, or for custom installations. Opting for a pre-hung door can simplify the installation process and ensure a better seal if the existing frame is compromised.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pre-hung door includes the frame and hinges, ideal for new installations or full replacements. A slab door is just the panel, used when the existing frame is sound.
